summary.policy: Strict zero-fabrication. No unverified internet rules or commercial folklore will be marked VERIFIED without physical edition scans.

canonical_editions.exact_title: Lal Kitab Ke Farman (The Edicts of Lal Kitab)
canonical_editions.author_compiler: Pandit Roop Chand Joshi (Girdhari Lal Sharma compilation circle)
canonical_editions.historical_significance: First edition. Introduces the foundational grammar of Lal Kitab, fixed house signification, and initial farman concepts.
canonical_editions.copyright_status: Published 1939 in British India; out of copyright / public domain under Indian Copyright Act Section 22 (author deceased over 60 years ago).
canonical_editions.required_for_engine: Optional reference for historical tracking of farman evolution.

canonical_editions.exact_title: Lal Kitab Ke Arman (Ilm Samudrik Ki Lal Kitab)
canonical_editions.historical_significance: Second edition focusing on palmistry, line formations, and correlation with planetary houses.
canonical_editions.copyright_status: Published 1940 in British India; public domain.

canonical_editions.historical_significance: Pocket edition (gutka) designed for field reference by practitioners, summarizing core remedies and aphorisms.
Significantly amended and systematized edition. Expanded treatment of debts (rin), asleep planets, and house interactions.
canonical_editions.required_for_engine: High priority: essential for validating ancestral debts and foundational rules.

canonical_editions.exact_title: Lal Kitab (Bhrigu Samhita Tarmeem / Lal Kitab Chamatkar)
canonical_editions.historical_significance: Master final edition containing complete planetary placements across 12 houses, Varshaphala calculation rules, and all 9 ancestral debts.
canonical_editions.copyright_status: Published 1952; public domain in India under 60-year post-mortem rule.
canonical_editions.required_for_engine: MANDATORY PRIMARY SOURCE: The entire production Lal Kitab prediction and remedy engine must be anchored to this edition.

preferred_variants: Authoritative Devanagari transliteration with parallel original text (e.g., Pt. Beni Madhav Goswami or Pt. Krishna Ashant edition)
Clean OCR text corpus corresponding to exact physical page numbers
